workflow_runs.name: Scheduled Tasks R1 installed Task real macOS Chrome
workflow_runs.display_title: Keep Time Review delivery accountable to genuine Mac evidence

head_commit.message:
Keep Time Review delivery accountable to genuine Mac evidence

Extend the existing controlled CFT driver and preserve raw acceptance evidence.
The tested production candidate has 205 passing affected Node tests and 34 of
35 native results; foreground contention leaves official upgrade unverified.

Constraint: Only main; preserve daily Chrome, its watcher, and parallel work.
Rejected: Passing CI on an incomplete full native run | missing evidence cannot become PASS.
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: moderate
Directive: Preserve PARTIAL and all raw failures until remaining native cases are genuinely executed.
Tested: Frozen dba771cc production inputs; 205 Node tests; official tool/check/both builds/verify; 34 real CFT cases; current driver syntax and Swift compilation.
Not-tested: Complete delivery-candidate native acceptance; official upgrade blocked by competing CFT foreground; active SW natural sleep/wake; independent native authority-field tampering; other-tool cross-version upgrades.
